question: For a AI use case involving AI data centers, where would Vector Network Analyzer fit in the test workflow?
answer: In the Vault's AI-data-center / AI-server material, the Vector Network Analyzer (R&S ZNA / ZNB / ZNL, plus ZNA67EXT) sits in the passive/channel characterization stage of the test workflow — i.e. S-parameter work on the interconnect before and alongside active protocol or BER testing. The AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping places ZNA/ZNB on server PCB for insertion loss (IL) and TDR, on server motherboard/PCBA for high-speed trace test, on connectors/cables for high-speed cable test (with OSP switching), on GPU for TDR, and on switch/IC vendors alongside FSWP; ZNL is listed as the entry for PDN Target Z, and an 'optical VNA' ZNA/ZNB combination is listed for silicon photonics. Mapped onto the R&S PCB test flow, that means the VNA appears at material measurement (impedance/TDR, Dk/Df extraction), material/stackup selection, signal-integrity modeling/testing, sampling testing and process monitoring — stages all expressed as IL, Dk/Df, roughness and impedance. In the SerDes SI/PI overview, network analyzers are explicitly the instrument class for the Power Distribution Network block (together with scopes), while scopes/BERTs/AWGs/switch matrices handle interface test — so the VNA is the channel and PDN-impedance instrument, not the link/eye-traffic instrument. The ZNA product page supports this role through options such as ZNA-K2 time-domain analysis (TDR), ZNA-K20 eye diagram, ZNA-K210/K220/K230 de-embedding and ZNA-K231 Delta-L PCB characterization. The probing/de-embedding case page stresses that the deciding factor is the total solution — VNA plus probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool and local partner — and shows VNA integration into inline/ATE setups (4-port ZNB3044 with OSP320, flying probe module, interposer board). Important limitation: these are Excel-derived sales-mapping and case-sharing clues; the Vault states no formal test setup, option, fixture, frequency range, calibration method or S-parameter settings are given, so they must not be used to build a formal configuration or quote.
missing: The Vault gives no formal VNA test configuration for AI data center work — no frequency ranges, port counts, option/firmware codes, fixtures, calibration methods or S-parameter settings; the 112G PAM4 PCB Engineering source has an empty VNA column with no model. It also does not define an explicit end-to-end AI-data-center test sequence that positions the VNA step relative to BERT/scope/optical link testing; that ordering is inferred from the separate PCB test-flow and SI/PI instrument-mapping pages.

key_points.point: For AI-server PCB, the VNA (R&S ZNA/ZNB) is mapped to insertion loss (IL) and TDR measurements.
On server motherboard/PCBA the ZNA is listed for high-speed trace test, alongside ZNL for PDN Target Z and FSWP for clock jitter/LDO NSD.
key_points.quote: [[R&S ZNL]]: PDN Target Z；[[MXO]]: Power rail、multiphase DC、PI；[[ZISO]]；[[R&S FSWP]]: LDO NSD test、clock jitter test；[[R&S ZNA]]: high speed trace test

key_points.point: VNAs also cover connector/cable and GPU/CPU/IC interconnect characterization, including high-speed cable test with OSP switching and TDR on GPU.
key_points.quote: [[R&S ZNA]] 也出現在 [[伺服器主機板]] / PCBA 的 high speed trace test、[[GPU]] 的 TDR

key_points.point: The R&S PCB test workflow stages where these VNA measurements land are material measurement, stackup selection, SI modeling/testing, sampling testing and process monitoring.
key_points.quote: 涵蓋 material measurement、stackup selection、signal integrity modeling/testing、sampling testing 與 process monitoring

key_points.point: In the SerDes SI/PI test map, network analyzers are the instrument class for the Power Distribution Network block, while interface/link test uses scopes, BERTs, AWGs and switch matrices.

key_points.quote: [[Power Distribution Network]] 對應 scopes 與 network analyzers
